title: Totem Indicator
description: Displays a pulsing HUD warning when you have a Totem of Undying in your inventory but nothing in your offhand. Toggleable with /totemindicator.
body:
# Totem Indicator — Never die with an unused Totem again!
Totem Indicator is a lightweight Fabric client-side mod that warns you when you have a Totem of Undying in your inventory but not in your offhand — so you never die with a totem sitting unused in your bag.
Features

- 🪬 Displays an on-screen HUD warning when a totem is in your inventory but your offhand is empty
- 🚫 No false triggers — only activates when your offhand is completely empty
- 📦 Automatically hides when any inventory or container screen is open
- ⚙️ Toggle the indicator on/off with /totemindicator

## How it works
The indicator appears as a pulsing panel in the center of your screen showing the totem icon along with a warning message. As soon as you move the totem to your offhand (or your offhand is no longer empty), the warning disappears.
## Commands
- 
```
/totemindicator
```

- Toggles the HUD indicator on or off 
## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
- Fabric API
